items.description: During a long trip, you get into an accident from which one of the residents of an abandoned, destroyed and overgrown village hundreds of years ago rescues you. When you wake up in the house, you will not be able to look around right away, poor eyesight is in the way, since the owner of the house left glasses on the bedside table. Having examined the surroundings, in addition to strange signs and frightening creatures, you notice: a forgotten camping site, an old gas station, a broken communications tower, an abandoned factory where residents used to work, and even a football field! However, the looters did their job, but still left some things that you will need to get out of here in various ways, until the creatures that settled these lands drove you crazy and killed you. In order to successfully leave the territory, you have to explore the location where you will find many puzzles: from entering code values to revealing mysterious symbols with what comes under your arm or foot: notes, objects, floor slabs. On the way you will come across hostile creatures with whom you should avoid contact. Depending on the actions, a new way will open up to leave the mystical place and it will not always be successful. Find the right chain of events and survive in Glasses Nightmare. Features: - 6 scenarios: uncover all the secrets of this place or try to leave in another way. - cunning enemies: even if you hid, they will try to find you. - many puzzles, solving which you will achieve your goals - free gas, you only need a canister! items.description: [h1]Dungeons of Uhr – A First-Person Survival RPG[/h1]Descend into the Depths… If You DareIn Dungeons of Uhr, you awaken in a vast, uncharted cave system with nothing but your wits and a strange letter. The air is thick with the scent of damp stone and something far older—something watching from the shadows. To survive, you must explore, scavenge, and fight your way through twisting tunnels, forgotten ruins, and caverns teeming with unspeakable horrors.Game Features:[h3]1. A Living, Breathing Cave System[/h3]Discover ancient ruins, underground lakes, and bioluminescent forests where light is your only ally.Navigate environmental hazards—collapsing tunnels, toxic gases, and pitch-black abysses.[h3]2. Fight or Flee[/h3]Dynamic Combat: Wield makeshift weapons, crafted traps, and rare relics against cave-dwelling beasts and twisted entities.Stealth & Survival: Some horrors are best avoided. Move silently, extinguish your torch, and pray they don’t hear you.Boss Encounters: Face towering subterranean monstrosities guarding the deepest secrets.[h3]3. Craft, Adapt, Survive[/h3]Scavenge Resources: Mine ore, harvest fungi, and loot the remains of lost explorers to craft tools and upgrades.Build Safe Havens: Reinforce crumbling tunnels, rest at camp, and light braziers to keep the darkness at bay.Upgrade Your Gear: From rusty daggers to enchanted lanterns, every piece of equipment could mean life or death.[h3]4. Uncover the Dark Truth[/h3]Piece Together the Mystery: Who built these ruins? What lurks in the deepest chasms?[h3]5. Friend or Foe[/h3]Travel in a company, hire mercenaries with their own goals and lore.Echoes of the Past: Find journals, ghostly visions, and cryptic carvings that reveal the cave’s cursed history.[h3]5. A Haunting Atmosphere[/h3]Stunning, Immersive Visuals: Realistic cave formations, dynamic shadows, and eerie bioluminescence.Sound Design That Chills: Distant whispers, skittering claws, and the groan of the earth itself pull you deeper into dread.Will You Escape… Or Become Part of the Darkness?Dungeons of Uhr is a hardcore survival RPG for those who dare to face the unknown. Every step could be your last. Every light could be your salvation. Subscribe to our newsletter Get STEAM deals and FREE games in your inbox Game developers Want your game sold on DailyIndieGame? items.description: What is Zulup? You play the role of a ball moving on the inside of a circle. Along the way, collect regularly appearing points. As you gain points, extraneous balls appear nearby, which differ from your ball in size and speed. Their task is to catch you and ruin your game. You can jump on the opposite side of the circle to avoid a collision or destroy another ball by hitting it exactly and thereby make the playing field a little freer. Your task is to score the most points without hitting other balls. Additional excitement will add a leaderboard and achievements.
